# netbox_mac_address (Data Source)

Fetches a single MAC address from Netbox by ID.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (Number) The numeric ID of the MAC address.

### Read-Only

- `assigned_object_id` (Number) The ID of the assigned object.
- `assigned_object_type` (String) The type of the assigned object (e.g., dcim.interface, virtualization.vminterface).
- `comments` (String) Comments for the MAC address.
- `description` (String) Description for the MAC address.
- `mac_address` (String) The MAC address.
